verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs confirm it's a block-based markdown editor with page/block references, queries, journals, and export to standard Markdown, and community reports embedded PDF reader and Github sync working well, implying rich formatting support. However the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of headings, callouts, tables, or code-block syntax, and community reports flag real editing friction (paste turns everything into bullet lists, poor performance on long-form/multi-paragraph text, limited checkbox support) that undercuts the 'fast keyboard-driven editor for rich formatting' claim. missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of headings, callouts, tables, code blocks; independent hands-on confirmation these render well; resolution of reported paste/performance issues with long-form content.
